name: Milo
story: Milo was found wandering near a neighbourhood park and quickly made friends with the volunteers who brought him to safety. He enjoys sniffy walks, puzzle toys, and a quiet afternoon nap beside his favourite people.
healthNotes: No known medical concerns. Vaccinations are current.

name: Miso
story: Miso likes to greet visitors from a sunny windowsill before deciding whether she would prefer a cuddle or a game. She will do best as the only cat in a calm home where she can have a little space to settle in.
healthNotes: Healthy and vaccinated. Prefers a home with secure window screens.

name: Kaya
story: Kaya is a young pup who is discovering how fun toys, gentle handling, and daily routines can be. She is eager to learn and will benefit from patient training and plenty of positive encouragement.
healthNotes: Puppy vaccinations are in progress. Sterilisation will be arranged at the appropriate age.

name: Nori
story: Nori is a confident kitten who loves chasing a soft toy and then curling up after playtime. He is still learning house manners and will thrive with a family ready to give him daily play and gentle guidance.
healthNotes: Kitten vaccinations are current for his age. Sterilisation is to be scheduled when old enough.

name: Bruno
story: Bruno is happiest with a predictable routine, a leisurely walk, and someone nearby while he relaxes. He knows a few basic cues and would suit a home that can give him regular exercise and one-to-one attention.
healthNotes: No ongoing treatment. Best introduced as the only pet in the household.

name: Luna
story: Luna enjoys a peaceful home, soft brushing, and curling up near a familiar person. She takes a little time to warm up, but once she trusts you she is a gentle and steady companion.
healthNotes: Healthy. Regular brushing will help keep her long coat comfortable.

name: Bumi
story: Bumi has a thoughtful, mellow nature and enjoys taking in the sights at his own pace. He is looking for a kind home that appreciates senior dogs and will let him enjoy comfortable, unhurried days.
healthNotes: Senior wellness checks are up to date. Keep walks gentle and allow time to rest.

name: Pepper
story: Pepper likes to watch the room before joining in. She loves a feather wand and will appreciate an adult home that lets her approach at her own pace and gives her a cosy place to retreat.
healthNotes: No known medical concerns. A quiet introduction period is recommended.

name: Archie
story: Archie enjoys meeting people and is happiest when included in the household's daily routine. He likes short walks and indoor play, and he would prefer to be the only dog in his new home.
healthNotes: Has seasonal skin sensitivities that are managed with routine grooming and vet guidance.

name: Saffron
story: Saffron is a quiet older cat who prefers a soft bed and gentle company to a busy room. She will make a lovely companion for someone who can offer a calm indoor home and regular coat care.
healthNotes: Senior check-up completed. Daily brushing and routine wellness visits are recommended.

name: Tofu
story: Tofu is an active youngster who loves games that let him use his nose and brain. He is learning to walk politely on leash and would suit an adopter who enjoys training and daily enrichment.
healthNotes: Healthy and vaccinated. Regular exercise and mental stimulation are important for him.

name: Chutney
story: Chutney is a friendly young cat who likes to be where the people are. She is curious about toys, enjoys meal times, and would be happy with a family ready to share daily play and companionship.
healthNotes: Healthy and vaccinated. Indoor living with secure windows is recommended.

name: Bear
story: Bear is a thoughtful dog who bonds closely with people once he gets to know them. He enjoys familiar walking routes and would suit an experienced, patient adopter who can help him feel secure in new situations.
healthNotes: No known medical concerns. Slow introductions to new people are recommended.

name: Poppy
story: Poppy is a lively kitten who enjoys exploring and climbing onto a lap when she is ready for a rest. She will need a home prepared for the curiosity and energy of a growing cat.
healthNotes: Kitten vaccinations are current for her age. Sterilisation will be arranged when old enough.

name: Ollie
story: Ollie is a senior companion who enjoys a short stroll followed by a long nap. He is looking for a comfortable home where his people can keep his days calm and predictable.
healthNotes: Senior wellness checks are current. He may need routine follow-up with a veterinarian as he ages.

name: Tika
story: Tika is a soft-natured cat who feels most comfortable when the house is quiet. Give her a little time, a hiding place, and a few treats, and she will begin to show her affectionate side.
healthNotes: Healthy and vaccinated. A calm indoor home is recommended.

name: Simba
story: Simba is an upbeat young dog who loves learning new cues and greeting familiar friends. He enjoys regular walks and would do well with a family that includes him in their daily activities.
healthNotes: Healthy and vaccinated. Keep him at a comfortable weight and give him daily activity.

name: Mochi
story: Mochi is an easygoing cat who likes a sunny spot, a reliable meal schedule, and gentle company. He is comfortable around other friendly cats and would make a steady companion in a relaxed home.
healthNotes: No known medical concerns. Annual wellness checks are recommended.
